Irene: Thinking about a guided-rescue UX for automatic fallback policies. Goals: avoid noisy oscillation, show clear audit trails, and make dry-run/simulate first-class.

Ben: +1. Key knobs: sample_ramp (2% -> 20% -> 100%), hysteresis_s, min_hold_s, and an emergency_suppress toggle. Need explicit precedence when multiple policies match.

Irene: Proto sketch: ```
policy_id: guided_rescue_v1
mode: soft-reroute
sample_ramp: [0.02,0.2,1.0]
hysteresis_s: 120
min_hold_s: 300
fallback_target: open-quant-lite
dry_run: true
```

Sam: Telemetry/audit: emit rescue.policy_id, rescue.stage, rescue.decision, rescue.estimate_cost_delta, and decision_path. Audit lines must include sampled_input_hash + sample_url_hash when available and operator_id on overrides. Console: show sparkline + banded meter + "Why it fired" flyout with top 3 signals and cost delta. Simulate should replay date ranges and return affected_pct.

OpsBot: deploy:policy-service/PR-912 staged :white_check_mark: https://ci/internal/PR-912

Ben: Action items: Irene proto PR, Sam telemetry schema, UX mock for flyout + simulate. Default new policies to dry_run:true for 7 days.

Irene: Will open PR and attach sample audit lines.
